column2: A long time ago, the ancient peoples of Canada were united and stood amongst the powerful. Although that empire is long gone, we now have control over the region, and thus it is now time for us to declare a unified Canada once more!
Form the United States of America

A long time ago, the ancient peoples of America were united stood amongst the powerful. Although that empire is long gone, we now have control over the region, and thus it is now time for us to declare a unified United States once more!
Our riches and influence prove that we are more than just a regular city, and we must proclaim it as such!
The time has come to unite the mountainous region of old Colorado under one crown.
I can restore old Connecticut, one of the original Thirteen.
I can unite the Gardenian people under one flag.
Having united all the Springfields accross America, I can now form the Empire of Springfield!
We have recovered all the lands of Ousamequin's confederacy, and the time has come to proclaim a new Massasoit!
The time has come to unite the great Maritimes under one true crown of Acadia.
We must tear down the false Popes of Québec and bring back the true Church into the fold.
Call upon the minor nobles within the realm to serve in an army
The time has come to unite the West and East kingdoms of old Pennsylvania under one crown.
New England has always stood as the mightiest region of old America, if not the most disunited as well. Now that the era of conflict is over, it is time to proclaim my rule over all of New England!
New York is by far the most prosperous and most powerful state of the old Thirteen, and with my rule over it cemented, it is time to proclaim a new empire worthy of rivaling even Columbia!
The five Great Lakes of America are the largest lakes in the wide world, and by uniting them we will rival empires the likes of Canada and America!
Virginia was once the largest state of old America, stretching from the Atlantic in the east to the Pacific in the west. It is time to reclaim our place in the Sun!

The High Kingdom of the Two Carolinas was one of the great early post-Event empires, a realm so powerful it rivaled Columbia for its entire existence. Though its glory days are behind us, a powerful enough ruler may be able to proclaim its restoration...
Maine was once the greatest state of New England, and though its legacy may be growing weak, a powerful enough ruler can proclaim its restoration.
We can proclaim a New Acadia in the lands of old America.
The time has come to unify the great cities of the East into a mighty empire once more!
The antediluvian state of Louisiana has been divided between the Arkansans and the Caijuns for too long, let us restore its long-lost glories!
The antediluvian state of Texas has been divided for too long, let us restore its long-lost glories!

While the war with the Mississippians caused the fall of the old republic, the memory of our old glory still lingers within most of our minds. Now that the lands under the Lone Star are united once more, let us restore our long-lost glories!
Old America's greatest state must be reunited, let us become the heart of the West Coast!
The sacred land of Kališahr shall be brought together.
Once the Sunshine State has been reunified, we can at last restore it to true glory.
Restore the Council of the Three Fires
[k_wyoming.GetName] and [k_minnesota.GetName] will also be reclaimed if completely controlled.
[k_kenora.GetName] will also be reclaimed if completely controlled.
Unify the Land of the Giants
When we have reunified these sacred lands, I can declare myself the ruler of a restored Gibborel, which once belonged to our Giant ancestors.
The core territory of Deseret must be brought back together, as they once were for all who once arrived to this promised land.
When our faith stretches itself across the continent, we can at last fulfill the White Horse Prophecy and bring Zion upon the Earth.
The Living Baphomet led their faithful from the ancient city of Babylon, with enough power I shall be able to proclaim myself the living avatar of Baphomet!
Declare myself the child of the true God, Horus-Ra!

Klemes I. was the son of Horus-Ra and Pharoah of the Mississippi Empire long ago, but many believe he is not the only child of the Sun, but that there is another chosen child yet to be revealed. I believe that I am the chosen of Horus-Ra, and if I am it, then I could restore the title of Pharaoh.

The fall of the Mississippi Empire ended the primacy of the Oracle of the Sacred Madonna, nullifying what little authority the position had. Restoring such a position in subservience of a new Emperor would be a great boon for the Madonnite faith.
You may play with the fabric of time and launch a Abolitionist Revolution somewhere in the South.
Has at least 4 counties in a kingdom, which he holds or doesn't have a holder.
As a Custodite officer, I should associate with a branch of service.
Promote a promising junior officer to your staff.
With enough of America under our command, we can restablish the Northern Command and confirm ourselves as the Commander-in-Chief of all legitimate continuity of government.
As I learn more of [Root.Religion.GetRandomEvilGodName]'s truth, the more I want. Perhaps the time has come to practice the forbidden mysteries more seriously.
As a [Root.Religion.GetName], I can seek out a bard to serve [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName] and my court.
Hold a great blackmass together with your vassals and offer sacrifice to the gods for good harvests and success on the battlefield. This can only be done every ninth year.
You begin preparations for the black mass.\n

column2: Faithful Aquarians study and venerate several gurus whose teachings help us grasp the unity of the self and the divine, but it can help to adhere especially to one.
As an Aquarian, §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§! may choose to turn to the mystical art of divination in an attempt to foretell the future.
I must follow in the footsteps of a great Archetype.
Aquarian spirituality features many practices that are beneficial to one's health and spiritual union with the universe. Maybe I should explore a little deeper?

Ancient legends of the Chicano people speak of the origin of American civilisation - the land of Aztlán. Though Aztlán has persisted as our people's spirit and guide in the many years since its fall, the time has come for us to restore our ancient empire in all its glory.
As an Arcadian, I am expected to identify with the season of my birth. Perhaps I should tend to that...

The insistence of the LDS Church in upholding the controversial reforms passed after the death of Joseph Smith effectively split the faith into two. A powerful ruler who brings the opposing side to its knees could easily declare primacy of their sect, declaring it the one true Mormon Church.

In days long past, the ancient peoples of the plains in the great north stood disunited. That era is long gone and we now have control over the region. The time has come to unite the Prairies and found something new!
